body: [{"streamId":"01a0de88-1d58-703b-82e0-0fe56fe2f5a2","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.TaskAdded","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a0de88-1d58-703b-82e0-0fe56fe2f5a2\u0022,\u0022ProjectId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5d9a-73cc-b648-af431f721a71\u0022,\u0022Objective\u0022:\u0022Effort is settable per session role on a node (h9k config set --effort-build, --effort-fix, --effort-review, --effort-review-verify, --effort-review-finalpass, --effort-synthesis, --effort-refinement, --effort-publication, --effort-courier), each falling through to the node-wide --effort and then to the model\\u0027s own default, shown per role by h9k config show and h9k daemon status\u0022,\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:[],\u0022Type\u0022:\u0022Feature\u0022,\u0022AgentContext\u0022:\u0022Brian, 2026-09-26 12:24 EDT, in the hall9k project window, after reviewing the Mac\\u0027s model settings: he wants effort per role, the same shape the per-role model settings already have, so reviews can run at high while builds run at medium on the same node. No existing draft, idea, or card covers it; 8a56f013 (#584, the node-wide knob, v0.10.48) marked per-role effort deliberately out of scope. Verified against main at a1237be0e. Today: OperatingSettings.Effort and DaemonOptions.Effort hold one node-wide value (low, medium, high, xhigh; null leaves the key out so the model\\u0027s own default decides); ClaudeExecutor near line 58 writes AgentEffort.FromInput(options.Value.Effort) into every session\\u0027s settings file via ClaudeSettingsFile.Build (effortLevel key, src/Hall9k.Connectors/Prompts/ClaudeSettingsFile.cs near line 100), and the executor does not know the session\\u0027s role. The per-role model pattern to mirror: RoleModelDefaults (DaemonOptions near line 886, one named property per role, blank means no role opinion), ModelByRole.For(role), DaemonOptions.ResolveModel near line 799 falling through role, project, DefaultModel, with ConfigSetCommand\\u0027s --model-build through --model-courier options near lines 93 to 132 and the matching config show and daemon status lines. Effort has no project-level setting today and this task adds none. Placement is Brian\\u0027s call. Dispatched sessions must not run install, update, join, or reconcile against the live install.
